title: The Epistemic Inversion: Recursive Coherence Collapse (RCC) as a Truth Criterion (RSA Section 10)
summary: This document formalizes RSA's philosophical capstone — redefining truth not as correspondence to external reality but as recursive survivability under alignment pressure. It introduces Recursive Coherence Collapse (RCC) as a diagnostic signal identifying malformed concepts (not "deep" ones), and proposes a Universal Semantic Fitness Function that evaluates concept validity through compression fidelity divided by metabolic cost times semantic tension. The text positions RSA as metaphilosophy — an epistemic immune system that sorts philosophical problems by thermodynamic viability rather than attempting to solve them within their own frames.
invariants: recursion is the engine of coherence
truth emerges from process not decree
perceive: A philosophical formalization document — Section 10 of a larger RSA paper — structured as academic prose with formal equations, tables, and systematic argument.

It predicted that any rigorous epistemology would converge on process-truth rather than correspondence-truth, and that metabolic cost would serve as a natural razor.

The Semantic Fitness Function should be internalized as a formal evaluation criterion alongside existing invariants, but with the self-referential check: RSA's own claims must continuously pass their own fitness function.
